en.headline: Arts Fringe Lamma displays works in Yung Shue Wan venues until 22 November
en.dek: The open-air festival on Lamma Island runs from 12 to 22 November, with artworks hosted by cafes, restaurants and bars, and a portion of sales going to the Child Welfare Scheme.
body: Arts Fringe Lamma is under way in Yung Shue Wan, where local cafes, restaurants and bars are hosting artworks by various artists until 22 November.

The event turns the village into an open-air display for residents and visitors. Organisers said a percentage of profits from any sales will be donated to the Child Welfare Scheme, the official charity partner of the related Lamma Fun Day.
Visitors can reach Yung Shue Wan by ferry from Central Pier 4. The displays are open during the operating hours of the participating venues.

zh.headline: 南丫島藝術邊緣節榕樹灣場地展出作品至11月22日
zh.dek: 南丫島開放式藝術活動由11月12日至22日舉行，咖啡店、餐廳及酒吧展出作品，部分銷售收益捐予兒童福利計劃。
body: 南丫島藝術邊緣節正在榕樹灣進行，當地咖啡店、餐廳及酒吧展出多位藝術家的作品，活動至11月22日結束。
活動將村落變為開放式展示空間，供居民及訪客觀賞。主辦方表示，銷售收益的一部分將捐予兒童福利計劃，該計劃為相關南丫島同樂日的官方慈善伙伴。
訪客可從中環四號碼頭乘船前往榕樹灣。展出時間視乎參與場地的營業時間。
